title: Senior Product Manager – Universal KYC (MetaMask Passport)
description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. 
 Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.
 About MetaMask 
 MetaMask is building a future where users can unlock the full product stack through a single, seamless identity experience, enabling access to all features with trust, safety, and minimal friction.
 Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust.
 Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport , a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem.
 This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience . You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant.
 What you’ll do 
 You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements. Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes.
 What we are looking for: 
 Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products 
 Strong background in fintech , ideally with exposure to Web3 
 Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity
 Familiarity with compliance workflows , including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes
 Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams 
 Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience 
 What Success looks like: 
 Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction
 Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows
 Increased reuse of verified identity across products
 Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes
 Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution
 Attributes that will make you stand out 
 First-principles thinker with strong product judgment
 Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load
 Strong understanding of trust, privacy, and compliance trade-offs
 Clear, structured communicator who drives alignment and momentum
 High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguity
 Why This Role Matters 
 Universal KYC is a foundational unlock for MetaMask, enabling users to move from fragmented, repetitive identity verification to a seamless, reusable experience across the entire product stack. It establishes a scalable, privacy-conscious identity layer that strengthens user trust while meeting global compliance requirements. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of access, trust, and growth, critical to unlocking the next phase of MetaMask’s evolution.
 Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.
 The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range. 
 US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)
 $130,000—$187,000 USD
 In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.
 MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characte

title: Product Lead - AI Investing
description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.
 This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Investing areas.
 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.
 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.
 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.
 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.
 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.
 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.
 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.
 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.
 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.
 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.
 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.
 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.
 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.
 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.
 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.
 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.
 People who cannot go deep into product details.
 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.
 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.
 People who need large teams before they can create progress.
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Portugal. 
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Product Manager EV charging stations
description:
**This is Allego**
In this role you will manage and further develop the physical products that shape the customer experience and identity of Allego’s charging locations across Europe. Allego is the leading company for ultra-fast charging solutions to companies and consumers throughout Europe. We operate state-of-the-art high power charging facilities that can be used by all electric cars and every EV driver, providing a seamless charging experience. Our goal is to contribute to zero emission mobility and allow EV drivers to charge at the right place with the right speed. To achieve this, we are looking for a Product Manager who will work on the product portfolio for are charging station products
**About the job**
You will have broad responsibilities, you will manage and further develop the physical products that shape the customer experience and identity of Allego’s charging locations across Europe.
From signage and wayfinding to brand elements, canopies and other physical site features, you will take ownership of a diverse product portfolio and lead products from initial concept through development, testing and implementation.
In this role, you will combine strong product management with creativity and commercial thinking. You will identify where new or improved products can create real value and find the right balance between customer experience, brand value, cost and scalability.
You will work closely with (international) teams across Allego, including Marketing, Charging Technology, Network Development, Installation, Operations, and Procurement. You will also work with external designers, engineers, manufacturers and suppliers to turn ideas into tangible and scalable products.
In a nutshell:
* You will own and manage Allego’s physical site product portfolio, including signage, wayfinding, brand elements, canopies and other customer-facing site features.
* You will identify EV driver, market and business needs and translate them into clear product requirements and solutions.
* You will lead the end-to-end product development, from concept and business case through development, prototyping, testing and pilots.
* You will evaluate and optimize products based on customer value, brand impact, cost, scalability and operational requirements.
* You will coordinate internal stakeholders, designers, manufacturers and suppliers to develop and implement scalable solutions across our European network.
* You will use customer feedback, data, operational learnings and market trends to continuously improve the portfolio and identify new opportunities.
**This is you**
You are result driven, curious and highly self-motivated. You take ownership of your work, bring structure to complex topics and enjoy turning ideas into tangible products.
You have a strong sense for customer experience and design, while at the same time understanding the commercial side of product decisions. You are creative, but also pragmatic: you naturally challenge what value a product creates, what it costs and whether it can work at scale.
Your strong communication skills allow you to bring together creative, technical and commercial perspectives. You enjoy working with colleagues from different disciplines and countries, as well as with external partners and suppliers.
As our ideal candidate:
* You have 5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally with physical products, hardware, infrastructure or comparable products.
* You have experience managing products across the full product lifecycle, from customer needs and requirements through development, testing and implementation.
* You combine a strong customer mindset with commercial and cost awareness, balancing experience, quality, investment and scalability.
* You have a strong sense for design, usability and customer experience and bring creativity and curiosity to developing new solutions.
* You are comfortable developing business cases and product recommendations, using data and insights to support decisions.
* You can effectively work with designers, engineers, manufacturers and suppliers, bridging creative, technical and commercial perspectives.
* You are a strong cross-functional stakeholder manager with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and enjoy taking ownership.
* Experience in EV charging, mobility or infrastructure is a plus. A background in product/industrial design, architecture or engineering is also beneficial.
* You are fluent in English, willing to travel within Europe and able to work regularly from our Berlin office.
**Our offer**
This role gives you the opportunity to directly shape how EV drivers experience Allego charging locations across Europe. You will have real product ownership, taking products from initial ideas through development and testing to implementation across our network. What else you can expect:
* A competitive salary package; 70k – 90k annually.
* Hybrid working from our Berlin office, with options to also work from home.
* 30 annual leave days.
* Enrollment in the pension scheme.
There is a team of EV experts looking forward to you joining Allego’s journey. Interested? Please apply and we will be happy to talk to you soon.

title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d) – Logistik & Last Mile
description:
**Spannend, aufstrebend und verdammt schnell – wir sind flaschenpost!**
Wir liefern den Wocheneinkauf innerhalb von 120 Minuten zu unseren Kund:innen.
Gemeinsam mit über 20.000 Kolleg:innen schaffen wir es, eine komplette Branche neu zu erfinden. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2016 sind wir mittlerweile als Sofortlieferdienst für Getränke und Lebensmittel in nahezu allen Metropolregionen Deutschlands vertreten.
Seit 2020 ist die flaschenpost Teil der Oetker-Gruppe.
### **Technical Product Owner (m/w/d) – Logistik & Last Mile**
Um unsere Mission zu erfüllen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n **Product Owner:in**. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams digitale Produkte, die unsere Kund:innen zuverlässig mit ihren Bestellungen versorgen und unseren operativen Alltag einfacher machen, wobei du Herausforderungen aus den täglichen Delivery- und Logistikprozessen in passgenaue Produktlösungen übersetzt und die Customer- und Driver-Journey aktiv mitgestaltest. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Operations Research zu IT, Operations, Logistik und Warehousing.

* Du hast ein Studium in einem MINT-Fach abgeschlossen, zum Beispiel Mathematik, Statistik, Operations Research, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

* Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für logistische und operative Prozesse mit und kannst Optimierungs- und Planungsverfahren in diesem Kontext mathematisch nachvollziehen und auf ihre praktische Relevanz prüfen
* Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Statistik und Datenanalyse und kannst kleinere Analysen selbstständig durchführen. Kenntnisse in Analytics, Reporting oder SQL sind ein Plus

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Rematiq helps healthcare and life sciences companies move faster through complex regulatory and quality workflows with AI. Our mission is to reduce the complexity that slows medical innovation down and help more products reach patients faster.
We already work with leading healthcare and life sciences companies, including **Novartis**, solving real regulatory and operational problems in a highly complex industry.
As a **Technical Program Manager, Regulatory Monitoring**, you’ll own our Regulatory Monitoring product area end-to-end, combining hands-on technical ownership with product, team, and customer leadership. You’ll help build and lead a small team of engineers, set priorities and technical direction, and remain deeply involved yourself — reviewing code, debugging production issues, and shipping fixes when needed.
Regulatory Monitoring tells our customers what regulators published overnight. It monitors more than 70 regulatory sources across the EU, the US, China, and other markets, captures new and changed guidance, legislation, decrees, and consultations, and delivers them into the customer’s Regulatory Inbox. You’ll work directly with regulatory affairs teams at pharma and MedTech customers to turn their needs into a clear roadmap and make sure coverage, data quality, and reliability stay high. Coding agents build many of the sources, while engineers review and improve them.
We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.
**What you'll do**
------------------
* **Own monitoring end to end:** Turn customer needs and coverage gaps into priorities, specs and shipped sources, and answer for the coverage, reliability and relevance of what reaches the inbox.
* **Lead customer alignment:** Join customer calls, maintain the source list per customer, clarify scope, and separate what is included from what is an upsell.
* **Lead the scraping team:** Set priorities for two engineers, one on architecture and infrastructure and one on sources and features, and write the tickets and specs they build from.
* **Stay hands-on:** Review pull requests, debug failed production runs, and ship a fix yourself when that is the fastest way.
* **Shape the roadmap:** Decide what gets built next, including news feeds, ontology-based filtering and classification, and alerts when a regulator changes its site and a scraper breaks.
* **Scale source building with AI agents:** Improve the agent workflow that builds sources so the team adds more sources per week and more of them pass review the first time.
* **Build the team:** Help grow the Regulatory Monitoring engineering team and set a high bar for technical quality, ownership, and delivery.
**What we're looking for**
--------------------------
We are looking for a technical owner with product judgment, customer presence and the ability to read and write code.
You may be a strong fit if you have:
* **Relevant background:** 2+ years in product leadership (Founder, Head of Product/Engineering or similar) and at least 3 years of hands-on coding as a software engineer, ideally on a data product.
* **Hands-on technical depth:** You read a TypeScript pull request and judge whether it is correct, understand a Node.js and PostgreSQL service well enough to debug a failed production run, and can ship a fix yourself.
* **End-to-end product ownership:** You have owned a product with paying customers from scoping through prioritization and requirements to operations, and were measured on outcomes rather than on tickets closed.
* **Strong customer presence:** You run calls with enterprise customer teams independently, manage scope and expectations, and say no when a request is out of scope.
* **Team leadership:** You have set priorities for engineers, defined the requirements they built from and reviewed their work. Hiring experience is a plus.
* **AI-native working style:** You work with coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and have a view on how to make agent-built code reliable.
* **Operational discipline:** You notice a failed nightly run before the customer does, and you put monitoring and alerts in place so that this does not depend on you.
* **Fluency in English (mandatory).** German is a strong plus.
**We'll be especially excited if you**
--------------------------------------
* Have built or operated web scraping, crawling or data ingestion pipelines at scale.
* Know regulatory affairs or quality management, ideally in Pharma or MedTech.
* Have been a founder or a very early employee and can show founder-like ownership.
**Why Join Rematiq?**
---------------------
* **Real Ownership:** You will own a strategic product area end-to-end
* **Agent-First Engineering:** You’ll work at the frontier of how software gets built when agents become part of the core loop
* **Direct Business Impact:** Your work will shape product direction and drive real revenue
* **Meaningful Mission:** You’ll help leading healthcare companies move faster — and support more medical innovation in the process
* **Strong Customers:** We already work with leading healthcare companies, including Novartis
* **Small Team, High Agency:** You’ll work closely with founders in an ambitious, execution-focused environment
* **Tools That Match the Ambition:** Large token budget, real freedom to experiment, and the chance to push modern coding agents to their limits
* **Compensation:** Competitive salary and meaningful equity

title: Senior Product Manager | Product Knowledge & Intelligence
description:
Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail
Product data is the backbone of our marketplace. Every product page, search result, recommendation, and ad, and every answer an AI assistant gives about our products, depends on it. Whether a customer finds the right item, trusts what they see, and decides to buy is decided by the quality of that data.
With tens of millions of items, several countries and languages, and thousands of sellers, this cannot be solved with manual work. It takes scalable systems, and increasingly AI.
As Senior Product Manager, you own a key part of this backbone: how we enrich, evaluate, and prioritize product data, and how we make sure that customers, partners, and the many systems that rely on it can trust it. You will build scalable, backend-heavy products with a direct line to GMV, customer trust, and seller experience.
 You own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for scalable products that enrich, evaluate, and prioritize product data, from the first idea through architecture and launch to measurable impact
 You turn open-ended, ambiguous problems into clear sub-problems, a prioritized plan, and an execution path, and you defend your choices with data
 You design and drive AI-powered systems at scale: LLMs and machine learning for attribute extraction, validation, translation, and quality scoring across multiple languages. You make sure that results are measurable, reliable and cost-efficient
 You define how we measure the quality and reliability of content: what is “good data”, how do we know, and what do we do when sources disagree?
 You decide where to invest limited capacity first by quantifying business impact, risk, and cost per item and per category
 You work as the connecting point between Engineering, Data Science, Design, Search, Legal, Seller-facing teams, and other product teams. You translate business needs into technical requirements and technical trade-offs into business decisions
 You build the metrics, dashboards, and feedback loops that tell us whether the system works, and you present results to stakeholders up to senior leadership
 Your profile – this is what we expect from you
 You have extensive experience in digital product management or in related fields such as strategy or innovation with proven impact on users and business
 You approach problems in a structured way: you can break down unclear challenges, form hypotheses, test them with data, and prioritize with a clear rationale
 You have a good understanding of Data Science Models and when to apply them
 You are experienced in using LLMs in production environments. You also know their limits and how to check whether results can be trusted
 You are highly data-literate and outcome-driven, and you can turn metrics and user feedback into decisions
 You think in scale: you look for solutions that work for millions of items, in several languages, and with limited manual effort
 You are a strong written and verbal communicator, can explain complex topics simply, and can convince technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels
 You have a solid technical understanding of data flows, APIs, and system integrations, and you enjoy working closely with engineers
 You put the customer and the seller first and enjoy solving real pain points
 You enjoy working in an international, English-speaking team (C1 level) and in a fast-paced, pragmatic environment

 This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
 We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!

Who we are

title: Product Manager (Italy Market)
description:
Your Impact
 autarc is established in Italy: a significant number of Italian installers already run their solar, storage, heat pump and air conditioning business on autarc, supported by a dedicated local team. Italy is one of Europe's largest solar markets and added 4.83 GW of solar in the first nine months of 2026 across almost 150,000 projects. Residential demand is under pressure, so installers need to sell and deliver more efficiently.
We know this market in depth. Fire safety clearances for rooftop PV, F1 to F3 energy bands, energy communities (CER), Italian single-line diagrams, grid connection with the Modello Unico and the GSE, invoicing via Fatture in Cloud and the DiCo under DM 37/08 are already built into what we ship. Your job is to take that depth further and turn every new insight from the field into product. You join a team of 7 product managers that works very closely
with our CEO.
This is a builder role in an extremely fast-growing venture: you spend much of your time with customers across Italy, define how we win the market and ship every day.
Your responsibilities include:
 Visit Italian installers regularly across the country, from small residential teams to commercial EPCs, join sales calls and demos weekly, and turn what you see into product
 Define our positioning in Italy: why installers switch to autarc and where we beat the tools they use today
 Drive Italian localisation end to end, from design and offers to invoicing and technical documentation, with a focus on what customers ask for most (e.g. commercial PV, carports, lump-sum offers)
 Own the regulatory side (Modello Unico, GSE, Terna's Gaudì, DiCo under DM 37/08, Conto Termico 3.0 and taxdeductions)
 Build prototypes, tools and integrations yourself with AI coding tools and our APIs
 Get Italian requirements onto the roadmaps of our product teams, drive them to release and own KPIs such as sellability and win rate
 What You Bring
 2+ years in product management, a technical role or as a founder in a fast-moving startup
 You know Italian installer software. You have worked with or on solar or heating planning software, or an ERP for installers and trades in Italy, and you know exactly where these tools win and where they fail
 Deep understanding of the Italian energy market, or the ability to get there fast: Modello Unico, GSE, DiCo and incentives are your daily language
 Technical depth, pragmatic execution. You enjoy working through technical and regulatory detail, and you get it into the product quickly instead of perfecting it on paper. We ship every day
 You are AI-pilled and build things yourself. You have vibe coded real tools or apps, can read API docs and wire up an integration prototype on your own

 About Us 
 Logistics is a $12 trillion industry powered by hard-working people, yet much of its operational work is still manual and running on tribal knowledge. We believe another software tool won’t solve this, but we need to change how work gets done in logistics.
 That’s why we're building the autonomous supply chain: AI workers that support their human co-workers and coordinate the work across company boundaries. We automate workflows first, then connect trading partners, and finally orchestrate entire supply chain networks.
 As former logistics operators, we understand this industry inside out: its complexity, exceptions and the realities of running a low-margin business. We are backed by leading European investors and are building a new category for the global logistics industry.
 The Role 
 As our Product Lead , you will shape our platform strategy and own the product roadmap from first insight to shipped feature.
 We are building a scalable platform, not a services business. Every customer project teaches us something, and your job is to turn those lessons into platform capabilities that make the next customer faster and cheaper to onboard. You will decide what becomes a configurable platform feature and what we deliberately don't build into the platform.
 Tasks 
 Our product: 
 Logistica is offering a flexible platform that lets logistics teams automate document-based workflows. Our focus use case is simplifying the load carrier management (pallets, crates, etc.) for wholesalers and logistics service providers. From this niche we are expanding to adjacent use cases that cover post- and pre-shipment operations. Currently the platform combines unstructured data sources, automates workflows and helps connecting partners. It’s built upon the following principles:
 An AI-first approach to solve operational problems
 A flexible platform built for how logistics actually operates
 Built-in network features that help customers optimize across company boundaries
 What you will do: 
 Define what is a platform feature vs. a configuration vs. a customization. Our customers value our platform’s flexibility, but you help to strike the balance between scalability and speed
 Filter customer requests. You look past individual customer requests to the problem behind them, define the solution and ship it in steps that build on each other
 Drive self-service functionality. Enable non-technical operators to set up and optimize workflow automations without engineering assistance
 Design how our AI workers work. You go deep on how operators run load carrier accounts, document flows and exceptions. Then you translate that into agent behavior, extraction logic, human-in-the-loop flows and evals.
 Drive the roadmap end to end. You pull together input from customers, CS, sales and engineering, force the prioritization calls and write specs engineers want to build from.
 Stay close to users. You visit customers regularly in their warehouses, admin offices and HQs across Europe
 Make the product sellable. You shape the product narrative with sales, support key demos and feed market learnings back into our playbooks

 +3 years experience in product (AI, B2B software, tech platform businesses)
 Technical background or deep technical understanding

 German at C1 level, English for working in an international team

 Experience in logistics or supply chain

 An early-stage AI startup at a growth inflection point and product-market fit

 Co-shape how work is done in one of the largest global industries

Als Arbeitgeber ist es mehrfach ausgezeichnet und gilt in seiner Branche als einer der besten in Deutschland.

 Die IT ist in den letzten Jahren von gut 100 auf fast 700 Mitarbeitende gewachsen und baut gerade ihr Herzstück neu. Früher hat jedes Land sein eigenes ERP betrieben. Jetzt entsteht auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ein gemeinsames Template für alle Märkte, betrieben in einer eigenen Azure-Cloud, mit Power BI und Power Automate im Ökosystem. Die ersten Länder sind live, weitere folgen in den kommenden Jahren. Das Programm ist langfristig angelegt und hat volle Rückendeckung aus der Geschäftsführung.

 Du entscheidest mit, wie das ERP für mehrere Länder aussieht, und berichtest bis in den Lenkungsausschuss

 Viele Business-Central-Berater, Entwickler und Application Manager wollen irgendwann mehr Verantwortung für das Produkt übernehmen. Hier ist der Platz dafür, in einem Programm, das über Jahre läuft und in dem du an den Entscheidungen beteiligt bist.  Workation innerhalb der EU
 Betriebsrestaurant, Bikeleasing und Ferienbetreuung für Kinder
 Du-Kultur in der gesamten IT, regelmäßige Team- und Austauschformate
 Interesse? 
 Bewirb dich einfach mit deinem LinkedIn-Profil oder deinem Lebenslauf. Ich melde mich zeitnah bei dir und erzähle dir im ersten Gespräch, um welches Unternehmen es geht.
